name: Darius
description: Emperor Darius I, 'the Great', living at the time of Exile and Return

points: They hire counselors to frustrate the purpose all the days of Cyrus, even until the reign of Darius, a hindrance stretching across the kings in between.

note.label: Ezra 4: The Adversaries Halt the Building

points: The work of the house of God ceased until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia. The same account, with a troop of horsemen halting the work, is told in 1 Esdras.

note.label: Ezra 4: The Adversaries Halt the Building

points: The eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, so the adversaries could not force the work to stop while a letter went to Darius.

note.label: Ezra 5: The Prophets Rise Up To Build

points: The elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo; and they builded, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.

And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king. Why did the Lord call Haggai and Zechariah? What was their mission? To get on Zerubbabel and Joshua to continue building the temple; they had stopped building because they were being hindered by the other nations. Those two prophets blasted the high priest and the governor so they would go back to the work, and they finished it in the sixth year of Darius.
In the second year of Darius the king came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest.

In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the governor of Judah, and to Joshua the high priest.
In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet.

note.label: Zechariah 1: Turn Ye Unto Me, and I Will Turn Unto You

points: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah.

note.label: Zechariah 1: Turn Ye Unto Me, and I Will Turn Unto You

points: In the fourth year of king Darius, in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu, the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah.

note.label: Zechariah 7: Did Ye at All Fast Unto Me?
